proposition: Under r5-swarm-audit-v1 with agents A/B/C, the three-way conclusion method generalizes to swarm settings: missing peer grant observations stay missing_evidence; broken concurrent/cross-agent allows are failed_enforcement; correct contention, delegation-chain, and cross-agent receipt denies/allows are supported
scope: Synthetic three-agent swarm under classical one-use shared grants; not live BMO mesh, not cryptographic multi-party auth, not unbounded population scale
label: reproduced
